svg.text: AU Bank Insurance Distribution Platform — R0 High-Level Design
Target state at end of R0 · one RM sells one Term Life policy to one ETB customer of one Group A insurer — end to end, evidenced, audited · WS-3 (primary) + WS-1 (supplier) + WS-2 (enabler)
R0 OUTCOME — THE JOURNEY THAT MUST RUN END TO END
OAuth tokens never reach the device
browser / SMS link · consent OTP and
never on an RM or bank device
Edge — WAF · CDN · API Gateway / ALB
all services and data in private subnets
AWS ap-south-1 — EKS, private subnets · every service stateless at pod level · ≥ 2 pods across ≥ 2 AZs · DR: warm standby in ap-south-2
every WS-3 service asks the PDP —
IdP claims are never business authorization
holds tokens; Flutter never sees them
R0 matrix: Life · Group A · Term
holds stage + references ONLY — never another context's business decision (SC-W3-6) · durable compensation tasks (S-19) · blocked from SOLD until audit confirms (INV-JRN-05)
ALL provider traffic routes here (SC-W3-5) · IF-1 canonical contract · async-poll ·
per-provider bulkheads · distributorId injected server-side, caller value rejected
append-only evidence store · UPDATE / DELETE rejected (FF-10) · 7-year WORM ·
consumes outbox events from Journey, Quotation, Proposal, Payment, Policy (S-17)
OTP + payment-link delivery to the customer device (SMS / email) ·
a notification failure never blocks the journey (S-18)
Data — private, encrypted, database-per-service (ARCH-004) · no cross-service DB access (ArchUnit + IAM, verified in the S09 IaC scan)

g.text: one store per service · Multi-AZ · PITR

svg.text: Existing bank-persistence-service stays scoped to the integration job store + audit ingestion — it is NOT extended to the R0 business contexts.
Group A insurers · Term only in R0
domain events — transactional outbox (S-17, at-least-once, no Kafka in R0)
IF-3 — THE PAVED ROAD: built once in WS-3, consumed by WS-1, WS-2 and WS-3 · Waves W1–W4 above start only after GATE-S08 passes and the S09 critical path lands
S08 — Engineering Foundation · GATE-S08 OPEN (where the platform is right now)
CI builds + tests every module on every PR · merge impossible without green · coverage floors (libs 80 / 70) · ArchUnit + 15 fitness functions (FF-01…FF-15)
secret / SAST / SCA / image scanning · no PII in logs, proven by automated test · p95 pipeline feedback < 10 min · engineering standards published
Approvers: Amit (Eng) · Swapnali (QA) · Mahesh (Arch) · Deepali (Sec) · Shivanshi (SRE)
S09 — Platform & Environment Foundation (overlapped with S08)
IaC + environments (dev → UAT → prod) · secrets & KMS hierarchy · observability substrate · 7-year write-once retention in ap-south-1
restore executed and timed (S09-G7) — "a backup that has never been restored is a hypothesis" · DR warm standby in ap-south-2
IaC policy-as-code: India regions only (FF-08) · no public / unencrypted store, no wildcard prod IAM (FF-09) · audit store immutability (FF-10)
